scope: Read-only audit of the supplied remote-head snapshot, before concurrent parent cleanup. No refs changed and no branches merged/deleted by this audit.

interpretation.exact_ancestor_of_main: Commit reachability proves history is integrated; later reverts/removals may change current behavior.
interpretation.squash_merged_pr_head: Remote SHA exactly matches merged PR head; single-parent merge commit is reachable from main; aggregate diff stable patch IDs match.
interpretation.not_reachable_no_exact_pr_merge_evidence: Not proven integrated. May contain cherry-picked/reworked/equivalent changes; no assertion that all work is genuinely new. Preserve.
interpretation.ownership: Branch ownership cannot be inferred from names or ancestry. This audit does not authorize deletion of other-task/user branches. Preserve default, open PR24 and unmerged/unknown branches.
